sampling_precision.description: Sampling precision mode: 'normal' balances precision/overhead, 'high' for detailed analysis (high overhead), 'low' for high-load systems.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file for recording warnings and errors.

dump_file.description: Absolute path to the file for dumping screen data.

duration.description: Run time duration in seconds. 0 implies running indefinitely until killed.
